title: Find where work is lost
description: Read the platform's pipeline hop by hop at 0, open a hop's explainer, break a simulated panel and watch its failures land on the panel while the node hop stays at 0, then follow a component's row to its delivery series.

steps.caption: Platform health draws the path a sample takes from its run to the store, one hop at a time.
Each hop shows what it took in, what it handed on, and the share it lost. 0% is healthy.
Open the ingest hop. It says what counts as lost there, the keys it is read from, and the server component that records it.
Every hop is read from the same three keys, one series per kind, so one rule reads them all.
Touch Panel 2 is simulated, so it can be broken on purpose.
Unplug it. Every poll of it now fails.
Save. The simulator applies it on its next pull.
The failed polls land on the panel's own component, as its poll failures.
The node hop still reads 0%. A failed poll is a device that did not answer, not work the platform dropped. A hop that does lose a share is tinted, so it stands out.
Open the node hop. Each node's own share is a row.
Follow the node's row to its platform component.
The node's delivery series live on its component, one per kind, like any other metric.
